findings.issue: Null boundingBox is mapped to sentinel objects ({x:-1,...} / {width:0,height:0}) so the following assertions fail indirectly; the failure message then reports a misleading position/size rather than 'element has no box'.
findings.evidence: const box = (await part.boundingBox()) ?? { x: -1, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }; toBeVisible() is asserted just before, so the null path is practically unreachable.
findings.fix: Optional: use a non-null assertion or expect(box).not.toBeNull() for a clearer failure. Not required.

summary: CSS diff is exactly D-1 (flex-wrap: wrap on .config-seats li, margin-left: auto on .config-style); .config-seats/.config-style are used only by GameConfigScreen.tsx, so no other screen is affected. On desktop .seat-name (flex 1 1 120px) absorbs free space, so the auto margin resolves to 0 and rows are unchanged; the 6 Game Config e2e specs (incl. locked ones at 1280x720) pass 30/30 on chromium+webkit.
